How to add widgets:
1. Long-press the home screen → “+” → Scriptable → choose a size.
2. Long-press the widget → “Edit Widget” → Script: “Home Assistant ToolBox”.
3. Under “Parameter” enter what it should show:

• (empty) – overview
• lights – lights (tap to switch)
• heating – all rooms, heating:Living room – one room with history
• energy – consumption, history, electricity/water/gas today
• people – who is where
• room:Kitchen – temperature, lights and sockets of a room
• light:light.hall or light:Floor lamp – one entity, large
• …@Holiday home – another instance than the favorite
